added.summary: `<input type="file">` is now HTML's file upload control: a button (`::file-selector-button`, "Choose file…" unless the input has text) with the names chosen beside it ("No file chosen" before any). A press anywhere on the input still sends `filepick`. `::file-selector-button` rules now style the button as they style a `<button>`, where before they were accepted and styled nothing. `field-sizing: fixed` keeps the names at the width "No file chosen" takes.
